scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

apps.access_detail: Developer sandbox available; workspace app approval and scopes can restrict installation.
apps.surface: HTTP Web API + events; messages, channels, users and files
apps.note: A token does not grant access to every conversation; scopes and membership still apply.

mcp.scope: Slack account access; distinct from Slackbot as MCP client

apps.workflow: Read a message in a test channel
apps.next_action: Install a Slack app in a sandbox with minimum history scopes and invite it to one test channel before reading a message.
apps.success_criterion: Retrieve the seeded message; show that an unjoined or ungranted conversation remains inaccessible.
apps.alternative_action: Compare official MCP channel coverage against the required scopes; avoid capturing a personal Slack session as an app credential.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Free trial exposes Account SID and Auth Token; production messaging has additional requirements.
apps.surface: REST; SMS, voice, numbers and verification
apps.note: Separate trial restrictions and usage charges from the ability to get credentials.
apps.next_action: Use Twilio trial credentials to inspect a test messaging record and document trial restrictions separately from future send costs.
apps.success_criterion: Return the approved message's status without sending messages or changing phone-number settings.
apps.alternative_action: Choose a messaging-specific auth path first; add voice or verification only after their separate requirements are checked.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Register a Zoho client and authorize a workspace; free API entitlement not separately verified.
apps.surface: REST; messages, channels, users and bots
apps.note: Use the Zoho-oauthtoken header and correct regional account endpoints.
apps.workflow: Read a channel with regional OAuth
apps.next_action: Confirm Zoho Cliq plan access and authorize a test channel using the correct regional token endpoint and header.
apps.success_criterion: Retrieve the approved channel data and record the region, scopes and edition allowance.
apps.alternative_action: Inspect an authorized channel's network read only if the public API lacks the required field; document the session dependency.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.description: Integrated chat, docs and workplace suite
apps.access_detail: App ID and secret plus user/tenant authorization; organization approval and scopes may apply.
apps.surface: REST; messaging, docs, calendars, base and contacts
apps.note: Official MCP supports user and tenant token modes; validate the chosen app's permissions.

mcp.scope: User/tenant token modes and selected OpenAPI tools

apps.next_action: Obtain tenant approval, choose user or tenant token mode, and read one document explicitly shared with the integration.
apps.success_criterion: Read the selected document while an unshared document remains inaccessible.
apps.alternative_action: Use official MCP if its permission model and document tools match; otherwise scope a direct document API client.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: API and integrations available across subscriptions; install the API-key integration.
apps.surface: REST; messaging, channels and workspace operations
apps.note: MCP configuration requires the documented token headers, not a guessed generic bearer flow.
apps.next_action: Connect Pumble using its documented token headers and retrieve one approved channel or message through API or MCP.
apps.success_criterion: Return the seeded channel/message using the documented headers and account limits.
apps.alternative_action: Check MCP tool coverage before writing a wrapper; do not guess a generic bearer authorization scheme.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Developer app and bot token; server authorization and privileged-intent approval may limit scope.
apps.surface: REST + Gateway; guilds, channels, messages and interactions
apps.note: Build around bot permissions; do not treat a user login session as a bot API credential.
apps.next_action: Create a test bot, verify developer-account eligibility and grant it access to one test guild and channel.
apps.success_criterion: Read bot-visible metadata and demonstrate denial for an ungranted channel.
apps.alternative_action: Use the bot API and Gateway as appropriate; do not reverse engineer a personal user session into a self-bot.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Create a bot through BotFather; bot token is sufficient for the Bot API.
apps.surface: HTTP Bot API; messages, files and chat management
apps.note: Bot capabilities differ from Telegram user-account APIs; label this as the Bot API toolkit.
apps.next_action: Create a Telegram test bot and retrieve an update generated by a test chat, with explicit Bot API scope.
apps.success_criterion: Return the test chat/update identifiers and prevent unrelated update data from being logged.
apps.alternative_action: Keep user-account automation outside this toolkit; the Bot API and user-account APIs have different capabilities.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Meta provides test credentials/number; production requires a business setup and messaging permissions.
apps.surface: Graph HTTP API; messages, templates, numbers and webhooks
apps.note: Use scoped system-user tokens for deployment; do not equate a temporary test token with production approval.
apps.next_action: Use Meta's WhatsApp sandbox to inspect the test-number configuration and document token expiry and production prerequisites.
apps.success_criterion: Record the test phone-number ID, required permissions and the difference between test and production access.
apps.alternative_action: Plan system-user authorization and business approval separately; a temporary token is not a production solution.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Account API credentials or OAuth integration; free developer entitlement not established.
apps.surface: REST; calls, contacts, users and numbers
apps.note: Basic credentials and OAuth are both supported; production requires access to a customer account.
apps.next_action: Confirm Aircall account entitlement, then read one test call with Basic credentials or a scoped OAuth installation.
apps.success_criterion: Return the approved call identifier and metadata while documenting customer-account prerequisites.
apps.alternative_action: Capture the authorized call-detail UI only to investigate a required metadata field absent from the public response.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Developer site offers a trial; credentials and billing constraints vary by API product.
apps.note: Some products require application JWTs, others key/secret Basic auth; avoid one auth adapter for all APIs.
apps.next_action: Select the specific Vonage product, identify whether it uses key/secret or application JWT authentication, and read a test resource.
apps.success_criterion: Record the product-specific auth scheme and retrieve the chosen resource without sending messages or calls.
apps.alternative_action: Keep separate adapters for messaging and voice when their credential flows differ.
